name: Muv-Luv Substance
original_name: マブラブ・サブスタンス
source:
Muv-Luv Substance (マブラブ・サブスタンス), stylised Sub Stance, is a free doujin, three-part spin-off/parody, game to the original Muv-Luv, and was released in 2005.

The premise is that Takeru, who has experienced both Extra and Unlimited world lines, wakes up in a parallel world that is exactly the same as Extra. However, this new world is fatally different, nicknamed Substance. Once again, reality mercilessly invites him to adventure, and to seek out his original world. After meeting with Kouzuki Yuuko, he must await X-Day, and survive the tomboyish heroine(s) standing in his way.
translation:
Muv-Luv Substance（マブラブ・サブsutansu），风格化的Sub Stance，是一款免费的同人、三部分衍生/模仿游戏，原版Muv-Luv于2005年发行。

前提是经历了Extra和Unlimited世界线的Takeru在与Extra一模一样的平行世界中醒来。然而，这个新世界却有着致命的不同，被昵称为“物质”。现实再次无情地邀请他去冒险，去寻找属于他的原来的世界。与光月优子会面后，他必须等待X日，并在阻挡他道路的假小子女主角中幸存下来。
